body:
Follow-ups from the Cost Explorer ChatGPT-parity pass (branch `feat/cost-explorer-chatgpt-parity`). Everything in priorities 1–5 of the parity brief landed; the items below are what remains of the two ChatGPT explorers' feature sets, each with its blocker or reason noted. Nothing here blocks the parity PR.

## Site 1 (aa-task-cost-explorer) remainders

- [ ] **Band-comparison lane charts** — groups 3–6 (fastest per intelligence band, smartest per speed band, fastest per cost band, cheapest per speed target) render as lane charts on Site 1; the parity PR ships the tables. Add lane rendering over the same band computations.
- [ ] **Main-scatter comparison lines** — smoothed upper-tail expectation, smoothed upper-envelope frontier, and the OLS cost–score trend line as toggleable overlays on the cost × score chart (the exact frontier and fitted-trend math is documented in Site 1's Data & methods tab).
- [ ] **Per-chart view settings** — third-metric limit modes per chart (unset / at most / at least + thresholds, plus per-band limits), chart-label modes (key choices / all / none), and magnification (fit / 150% / 200%).
- [ ] **Unpriced-variant detail buttons** under the main chart (configurations with a score but no published cost, listed as buttons opening the detail card). Partially covered today by chart 6 (scores-only bars) and the configurations table.
- [ ] **Per-band recommendation overrides** ("Tune this band": per-band tradeoff overrides, absolute limits per band, band split/merge). The parity PR has global tuners only.
- [ ] **Provisional-estimate points + include-estimates toggle** — blocked on measurement provenance in the #1248 event log, same deferral as PR #1364's guest-estimate markers. Site 1's `reviewed-data.json` holds the estimate set.
- [ ] **Evidence & anecdote cards** (Data & methods) — the notes/event log from #1248 is the home for these; seed from Site 1's five cards when the notes surface exists.
- [ ] **AA directory table with OpenRouter ranks + OpenCode Console ids, and the OpenRouter/OpenCode coverage-check table (188 listings)** — the fleet feed carries neither dataset today; needs a collector source before the page can render them.
- [ ] **Design references & historical snapshots section** (Site 1's Data & methods) — historical artifacts; link the Drive/site originals rather than re-hosting.

## Site 2 (drew-coding-model-explorer) remainders

- [ ] **Projection pricing routes** — Site 2 prices the projection per route (Direct/benchmark API, OpenCode Console, OpenCode Go allowance). The parity PR prices from the recorded event-log rates only (one rate set per model). Needs per-route price events in the log before the selector means anything.
- [ ] **Cache-storage hours in the projection** — no storage rate exists in the price event log; add the field to price events first.
- [ ] **Gemini promo vs Jan-2027 rates toggle** — no promo windows recorded in price events yet.
- [ ] **Throughput / latency factor sliders** for the projected time (Site 2's speed assumptions).
- [ ] **Shortlist side-by-side compare (up to 6)** for catalog models — the parity PR has row detail cards and the recommendations shortlist; a pinned compare tray for the Model Explorer is the remaining piece.

## Data notes

- Site 1's linked datasets (`reviewed-data.json`, `data.csv`, CAI snapshots, coverage/cost/score audits, the CAI AInventory workbook) sit behind the ChatGPT login gate; retrieval needs the signed-in session or Aster's Drive upload (asked for in Slack #alignment). The parity PR proceeded from the signed-in browser inventory; pull the datasets when they land and diff the CAI observations against ainventory's `benchmark_results` as a cross-check.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Each remainder item listed in the body is either implemented or explicitly deferred with a named follow-up issue: Site 1 band-comparison lane charts (groups 3-6), main-scatter comparison-line overlays, per-chart view settings, unpriced-variant detail buttons, and per-band recommendation overrides.
- [ ] Lane charts render over the same band computations as the shipped tables (no divergent math).
- [ ] Nothing in the parity PR (#1390) regresses: existing Cost Explorer pages/charts still render and their tests pass.
